Hi Eline,

That error usually refers to an error in the Mplus file.
I'm not sure if this would cause any issue but it looks like the input file name has a space after the period before the inp, which is not typical.

On Wed, May 12, 2021 at 10:12 PM Eline Verspoor <verspo...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear list,

I'm new to MplusAutomation and I am trying to use runModels to run multiple .inp files in one folder. However, I'm getting this error for all models and I don't know what to do (as the single model does run if I'm running it from Mplus). Also, I can't find any output file where anything more is listed o the error. Do you have any idea where this could come from?

Kind regards,
Eline
